d: Kanagat, pitripaksh ke lie phataphat taiyar karen paranprik shraddh bhoj ki puri thali, aisi aasan aur svadisht resipiz bana rahe hain jinhen kam samay men taiyar kiya ja sakta hai. pitripaksh bhojan ki taiyari men samay kam ho to yah jhatpat resipi sirij aapko paranprik kanagat kombo jaldi banane men madad karegi
